items.question: What series of principles originates from the supreme primordial nature identified with the Goddess?
premises: The supreme primordial nature has the great principle as its first evolute.
That same nature is identified as the aggregate beginning with the great principle.
The preceding context identifies this supreme primordial nature with the Goddess.
items.inference: Therefore the Goddess, as supreme primordial nature, is the source of the series beginning with the great principle.
uncertainties: The exact extent of the series implied by ādi is not specified within this verse.
items.plain_english: That whose beginning is the great principle is that which is characterized as beginning with the great.
